evals.name: recover-lost-receipt
evals.prompt: Send one dispatch notice after ParcelCollected, including when the provider loses the acknowledgement.
evals.expected_output: Idempotent receiver keyed by reactor delivery identity.
assertions: Waits for the provider result and surfaces the initial failure.
Uses the same delivery ID across retries.
Asserts one visible effect after a failed then successful attempt.

evals.name: distinguish-retry-from-replay
evals.prompt: A developer disabled replay and says no ordinary retry can duplicate a charge. Review the claim.
evals.expected_output: Separates replay participation from retry deduplication.
assertions: Requires a stable key per logical delivery.
Requires an atomic downstream guarantee, not a local receipt written later.

evals.name: route-precommit-quotation
evals.prompt: A quotation must be obtained before deciding what fact to record. Should a reactor do this?
evals.expected_output: Routes pre-commit work away from the reactor.
assertions: Does not create a reactor to obtain the quote.
Explains that post-commit failure cannot reverse the accepted fact.
